facts.raw_span: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms for 40 days
No fever
No previous infections, family history, or personal medical history of autoimmune diseases or psoriasis
Diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair
All joints of both hands were swollen
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate: 27 mm/h (slightly elevated)
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)
Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis (hematoxylin-eosin stain)
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
Fundus fluorescein angiography showed uveitis

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of gradual hair loss, swelling and painful hand joints, and multiple asymptomatic nodules, along with laboratory and imaging findings, are consistent with sarcoidosis.
The patient's symptoms of swelling and painful hand joints, along with elevated rheumatoid factor, are consistent with rheumatoid arthritis.
The patient's symptoms of diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair are consistent with lupus pernio, a form of sarcoidosis.
The patient's symptoms of uveitis, as shown by fundus fluorescein angiography, are consistent with this diagnosis.
The patient's symptoms of multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms, along with skin biopsy findings, are consistent with granulomatous dermatitis.
The patient's symptoms of numerous acid-fast bacilli present on skin biopsy are consistent with tuberculosis.
The patient's symptoms of swelling and painful hand joints, along with imaging findings, are consistent with osteoarthritis.
The patient's symptoms of swelling and painful hand joints, along with imaging findings, are consistent with synovitis.

rationales.F12: Uveitis is a common manifestation of Sarcoidosis and other autoimmune diseases
